{"kind":"proof","text":"Let \(G\) be a nonabelian group of order \(21\). By Sylow’s theorems, the number \(n_7\) of Sylow \(7\)-subgroups satisfies \(n_7\mid 3\) and \(n_7\equiv1\pmod 7\), so \(n_7=1\). Thus \(G\) has a unique normal subgroup \(N=\langle b\rangle\) of order \(7\). By Cauchy’s theorem, \(G\) also has a subgroup \(P=\langle a\rangle\) of order \(3\). Since \(N\cap P=\{e\}\),
\[
|NP|=\frac{|N||P|}{|N\cap P|}=21,
\]
so \(G=NP=\langle a,b\rangle\).

Because \(N\trianglelefteq G\), conjugation by \(a\) is an automorphism of \(N\). Hence
\[
aba^{-1}=b^i
\]
for some \(i\in\{1,\ldots,6\}\). Since \(a^3=e\),
\[
b=a^3ba^{-3}=b^{i^3},
\]
so \(i^3\equiv1\pmod 7\). The solutions modulo \(7\) are \(i=1,2,4\). If \(i=1\), then \(a\) and \(b\) commute, making \(G=\langle a,b\rangle\) abelian, a contradiction. Thus \(i=2\) or \(i=4\). If \(i=4\), replace \(a\) by \(a^{-1}\); the resulting conjugation automorphism has exponent \(4^{-1}\equiv2\pmod7\). Therefore generators can always be chosen so that
\[
a^3=b^7=e,\qquad aba^{-1}=b^2.
\]

Now let \(G\) and \(H\) be any two nonabelian groups of order \(21\). Choose generators \(a,b\) of \(G\) and \(c,d\) of \(H\) satisfying
\[
aba^{-1}=b^2,\qquad cdc^{-1}=d^2.
\]
Every element of \(G\) has a unique form \(b^s a^r\), where \(0\le s<7\) and \(0\le r<3\): existence follows from \(G=NP\), and equality \(b^s a^r=b^t a^u\) implies \(b^{s-t}=a^{u-r}\in N\cap P=\{e\}\), proving uniqueness. The analogous normal form \(d^s c^r\) holds in \(H\).

Define
\[
\phi:G\to H,\qquad \phi(b^s a^r)=d^s c^r.
\]
The unique normal forms make \(\phi\) well-defined and bijective. Moreover,
\[
(b^s a^r)(b^t a^u)=b^{s+2^r t}a^{r+u},
\]
with exponents reduced modulo \(7\) and \(3\), because \(a^r b^t a^{-r}=b^{2^r t}\). The same multiplication rule holds in \(H\). Consequently,
\[
\phi\bigl((b^s a^r)(b^t a^u)\bigr)
=d^{s+2^r t}c^{r+u}
=(d^s c^r)(d^t c^u),
\]
so \(\phi\) is a homomorphism. Being bijective, it is an isomorphism. Therefore any two nonabelian groups of order \(21\) are isomorphic.","reason":""}
